info.title: Studio Apartment, Good Lighting, Angel Included
info.synopsis: Shintaro Tokumitsu è un liceale che vive da solo ma le cose prendono una piega inaspettata quando una ragazza si presenta sul suo balcone! Towa è incredibilmente pura e dolce, ma c'è qualcosa di diverso in lei... qualcosa di divino. Chi è in realtà la nuova adorabile compagna di stanza di Shintarō?

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: One morning, Tokumitsu Shintaro finds a strange girl asleep on his balcony. She seems nice, but she also claims that she's an angel and that she has nowhere to go...

tmdb.title: Episodio 1
tmdb.synopsis: One morning, Tokumitsu Shintaro finds a strange girl asleep on his balcony. She seems nice, but she also claims that she's an angel and that she has nowhere to go...

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Towa and Shintaro start settling into life sharing the apartment, but they have a lot to learn about living together. Still, they begin to find a rhythm before Shintaro has to return to school and insists that Towa can't follow him.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Shintaro has racked up a few explanations he needs to make at school, while blissfully unaware of it! And at work, his girl troubles escalate as he runs into an ice queen.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Shintaro and Towa return from their outing for sweet treats to find Shintaro's aunt collapsed at his door. This immediately throws the apartment into a panic as Shintaro has to somehow justify Towa's presence.
